Looping in the SDR playbook excerpt below (copy ready). Once Marissa confirms the queue mapping, we'll run the claim job and SDRs will follow this cadence.

--- SDR Outreach Playbook (excerpt) ---
- Hot: 3 call attempts within first 24 hours, leave tailored voicemail, email with replay link + 1-pager, owner adds "claimed_by" in comments. If no reply, schedule LinkedIn touch on day 3.
- Warm: email with replay + short case study, CTA to book 30-min demo. Follow-up at day 3 and day 7.
- MQL-Low: 5-touch drip over 30 days, purely nurture, route to marketing if opens/clicks > 3.

Suggested external-facing email template (use personalization tokens):

Subject: Thanks for joining — on-demand: Scaling LLMs + next steps
Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks again for attending our session on Scaling LLMs. We recorded a short highlight reel and compiled resources that might help your team evaluate deployment cost and latency tradeoffs.
Watch the on-demand highlight: https://redwood.shareable/replay/scaling-llms-on-demand
If you'd like to see a short walkthrough of how Redwood could fit into your stack, reply with times that work and an SDR will set up a 30-min demo.
Best,
{{sdr_name}}
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachments to push with claims: SDR_claim_matrix_v2.xlsx, replay_trim_v1.mp4

I will also include quick call scripts for FinLogic (Jessica), CloudSight, and Edgeware — see notes in the matrix. Approve and I'll confirm claim windows.
